const d=document.getElementById('sideDocs');if(!d)return; d.innerHTML=`

NES Forge ${R.version} — ${R.name}

A standalone visual NES editor, assembler, ROM builder and experimental emulator. Alpha · Roadmap Workbench candidate. Work through the existing tabs. Examples are ordinary editable project files included in the release package.

Start, open and recover

A fresh workspace starts with one blank scene. New Project creates a blank fixed room with the existing single-room build settings. Open Project loads a complete JSON or ZIP project. Browser recovery remains available through Restore / Dismiss; it is protected while being checked or awaiting your choice. New Project and Open Forge ROM have undoable replacement boundaries. A normal project open starts a new history.

Save your work

Save / Load use browser storage. Save Project As and Export create portable authoring backups, including worlds, tracker data, animations and the original imported ROM. Save As retains the existing location picker and download fallback. Cancel keeps the workspace. A save completing after you switch projects cannot rename or bind the newer workspace.

Project compatibility

Current projects use schema ${R.schema}. Supported older projects migrate with Gameplay Core disabled; their World and Audio Runtime settings are preserved when present. The frozen 1.8 editor rejects schema 12, protecting canonical actors, behaviors and scoped variables from silent loss. Unresolved behavior operations remain editable for repair and reject executable builds. Downgrade export is unsupported. Viewer/custom and single-room ROM formats remain layout 3, NFEX 1, MT16 1, WR16 3, MS16 2 and GP16 1. World ROMs retain layout 4 / WG17 version 1 and record their checked embedded source schema.
